AYAMOD-UPLOAD_ERROR_LOGS.title: Auto-upload Error Logs
AYAMOD-UPLOAD_ERROR_LOGS.description: When enabled, uncaught exceptions in mod code will be automatically uploaded to a remote server to help improve the mod.
AYAMOD-CONSENT_UPLOAD_LOGS.body:
[left]Enabling this option will upload error logs to the author's server.
The uploaded data includes only:
• Mod name and version
• Game version
• Operating system
• Error type and stack trace

No personal identifiable information or save data will be uploaded.

You can disable this option at any time in the settings.[/left]
